0.comment: Sigurd: The Bell of Mourning Echoes
0.content:
A world quest in Nod-Krai. Three Tideseal Stones, each besieged by the Wild Hunt, yield three relics (a bell, a horn and a tassel) while a strange figure in Lightkeeper garb fights beside the Traveler. Paimon takes them to Lushne and Sukhovykh in Nasha Town, who identify them as Sigurd's and ask that they be returned to his grave on Lempo Isle. At the grave the Traveler can return them and challenge the Local Legend.

The grave bears the Latin inscription "Pro aris et focis" (for hearth and home), a phrase also used as a motto by regiments and families; the quest's achievement shares the name.

1.content: An artifact set whose pieces were once Sigurd's relics: Lightkeeper's Pledge, Nightingale's Tail Feather, Undying One's Mourning Bell, A Horn Unwinded and Dyed Tassel. Its texts retell the Wild Hunt's return as a black-blood storm, the oath-bound Lightkeepers marching on it, and Sigurd's last stand. The folk saying that tolling mourning bells signal the approach of the one who swore to hunt the Wild Hunt comes from these texts.

2.content: Chicherin, a former Ratnik injured fighting the Wild Hunt, appears to have been close to Sigurd. Together they saved young Malusha, whom Chicherin adopted. Malusha, now a Ratnik, calls Sigurd her uncle. Chicherin has told Nefer he still dreams of Sigurd and intends to find him and put him to rest.

3.content: Nikita became Starshyna after Sigurd fell about a decade ago. He fought by Sigurd's side, and says the previous Starshyna would have lived up to an outsider's expectations far better than he does. He later took in Illuga after the Wild Hunt ravaged his village.
